credit.en: A fictional sound exhibition. The sculpture images are original AI concepts. Sound is synthesized in your browser.

kicker.zh: FOLD FREQUENCY   /   声音设计习作

body.zh: 看一道折痕，听三种音色。
body.en: One fold. Three ways to hear it.

notes.zh: 让观众先看蓝色薄片在哪儿转向。雕塑只是看声音的入口。
notes.en: Ask where the eye changes direction. The sculpture is an invitation to listen.

title.zh:
沿着高光，
读一条边。

body.zh: 靠近时，整件雕塑消失了。只留一条亮边，眼睛会沿它走到下一道折痕。
body.en: Move closer until the sculpture disappears. Follow one bright edge into the next fold.

notes.zh: 指出中间的转角，停留两秒。这里用形状来谈感知，并非声学测量。
notes.en: Point to the bend and pause. This is a visual analogy, not a measurement.

title.en: Hold the pitch. Change the wave.

body.zh: 先从正弦开始，依次切到三角和锯齿，听同一个音如何改变质地。
body.en: Begin with a sine wave, then switch to triangle and sawtooth. Listen for the change in texture.

notes.zh: 给听众留出安静的四秒，让他们对比同一音高下的音色。
notes.en: Leave four quiet seconds for each waveform at the same pitch.

title.en: The whole fold and the fine edge.

body.zh: 两张图分别承担轮廓与触感。比较相同的蓝在不同光线下如何变化。
body.en: Compare the silhouette at a distance with the surface at close range.

notes.zh: 并排指向两处高光，说明相同的材质为什么读起来不同。
notes.en: Point to the two highlights. Discuss what scale changes.

title.zh:
把它调成
你的声音。

body.zh: 选一种波形，停在喜欢的音高。把这两秒带走。
body.en: Pick a waveform, tune it to a pitch you like, and take two seconds home.

notes.zh: 打开试听台，演示保存再载入音色，最后导出 WAV。
notes.en: Open the listening desk. Save a patch, recall it, then export a WAV.
